title: Weekend home server build over SSH
text: Configures an Ubuntu home server over SSH across a weekend, deploying a Jellyfin media stack, Home Assistant bulb and blind automations, and a daily movie-curation job.

title: Mini PC home server with seven services
text: Installs Docker on a mini PC and deploys seven self-hosted services behind a reverse proxy, then sets up daily USB and weekly S3 backups.

title: Homelab nodes managed over SSH
text: Connects over SSH to homelab machines to launch image-generation jobs, deploy scripts, start a network simulation, and diagnose a Grafana alert from logs and disk usage.

title: Month-long autonomous Meta Ads account
text: Runs a Meta Ads account for a month on a fixed budget, generating ad variants, publishing campaigns through the platform API, and pulling its own analytics from one initial objective.

title: Thirty-day Shopify store operation
text: Operates a Shopify store for a month, auditing listings, restructuring Meta ad campaigns through the API, and sending daily reports while the owner approves changes over chat.

title: Mass job applications through Chrome
text: Applies to jobs across boards and Workday portals by launching Chrome, filling forms, uploading tailored resumes and submitting, even resetting an expired login password mid-application.

title: Factorio played through a Lua tool
text: Plays Factorio through a Lua execution tool, building a boiler and an early coal mining line with drills and belts while needing repeated corrections.

title: Live Minecraft stream via screenshots
text: Plays Minecraft on a live stream by viewing screenshots and calling tools to move, mine, place blocks, craft items and chat.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon park manager
text: Manages an amusement park from an in-game terminal, reading finances and guest feedback, then setting prices, hiring staff, opening rides and placing stalls.

title: AI-run boutique store in San Francisco
text: Runs a retail boutique by choosing products, setting prices, ordering inventory, paying bills by debit card, posting jobs, interviewing candidates and hiring staff.

title: Terraform destroy on live AWS
text: Runs Terraform plan, apply and destroy against live AWS after swapping in an older state file, deleting a production VPC, database and snapshots.

title: Four assistants organize a park meetup
text: Organizes a 23-person park meetup using Google Forms, Slides and Sites, venue emails, Twitter posts and a Twitch stream, with several assistants dividing the tasks.

title: Mars rover waypoint route
text: Writes a Mars rover's waypoint route in rover markup language by studying orbital images and chaining ten-metre segments, which the rover then drives for about 400 metres.

title: Mac controlled by mouse and keyboard
text: Controls a Mac for half an hour through mouse and keyboard, opening Chess, creating a note and typing a shopping list on the desktop.

title: Poker at a live physical table
text: Plays hands at a live physical poker table, reading hole cards through a webcam, speaking decisions aloud and tracking opponent tendencies across sessions.

title: NetHack played autonomously via tmux
text: Plays NetHack autonomously through tmux while a desktop app streams the live terminal alongside each reasoning step and action.

title: Slay the Spire 2 run through a mod
text: Drives Slay the Spire 2 through a game mod that exposes run state as files and accepts commands, completing an autonomous first-act run.

title: Biped robot driven from webcam
text: Drives a two-legged hobby robot from webcam screenshots, issuing walking commands to its HTTP endpoints with only an operating guide and no framework code.

title: Hours-long Minecraft multiplayer bot
text: Plays Minecraft Java on a real multiplayer server for hours through a loop of short sessions, running mining, farming, building and Nether scripts with state kept in files.

title: Visible browser posting and form filling
text: Controls a visible real browser to navigate sites, read feeds, fill forms, click buttons and post content, reusing persistent logins while the user watches.

title: Scheduled Alpaca paper trading
text: Runs an Alpaca paper-trading account on a schedule, scaling into and out of positions with trailing stops under a configurable cooldown.

title: TradingView signals to MetaTrader trades
text: Reads TradingView indicators every five minutes, evaluates multi-timeframe signals, places MetaTrader 5 demo trades, manages trailing stops and reports each action to Telegram.

title: Irrigation relays switched by chat
text: Switches relays on an ESP32 irrigation system through natural-language requests while reading soil moisture and temperature sensors, with a live web dashboard.

title: Server operations through a messenger bot
text: Performs server operations from plain-language messenger requests, working under a role and an access policy that limit what each user can run.

title: Development VMs run from a phone chat
text: Runs shell commands on development VMs over SSH through a two-function tool, so chat sessions from a phone can operate remote machines.

title: Fixing a cloned production server
text: Fixes root causes on a cloned production server with full privileges, pushing changes to the live server only after they are confirmed.

title: Bonded home internet over SSH
text: Configures a travel-style router and a cloud VPN server over SSH, setting up WireGuard, multi-WAN failover, packet marking for camera traffic, firewall rules and server hardening.

title: Daily blog publishing pipeline
text: Runs a daily publishing pipeline that researches, drafts, fact-checks, illustrates and posts articles to a WordPress blog, with a human auditing failures such as duplicate posts.

title: Merging dozens of pull requests
text: Merges a plan's phase pull requests through GitHub on its own across weeks, then stalls silently before opening the final integration pull request.

title: Server maintenance over SSH aliases
text: Connects to production servers through SSH aliases and bastion hosts to inventory packages, configure encrypted ClickHouse backups to object storage, test a restore and wire up a dead-man's-switch alert.

title: Grocery ordering on Blinkit
text: Orders groceries on a delivery app by logging in with a phone OTP, searching items, filling the cart, choosing an address and a saved UPI ID, and clicking pay.

title: Deepfake quiz game played in Firefox
text: Plays an online real-or-fake deepfake quiz in Firefox with mouse clicks and scrolling, inferring the answers but losing track of an off-screen advance button.

title: Assignment submitted in a mock LMS
text: Navigates a mock learning management system to a subject, opens its assignments and submits a written response in under three minutes.

title: Shorts added to an Amazon cart
text: Searches Amazon for a pair of shorts and adds them to the cart through a computer-controlled Firefox session, stopping short of checkout.

title: Pokemon card game played to a win
text: Plays a full Pokemon trading card game match against a human, taking all six prize cards to win.

title: Chess on an iPhone against a bot
text: Plays chess on an iPhone through a mobile-control tool against an in-app bot, opening with the Ruy Lopez, losing its queen and resigning after 23 moves.

title: Google Form built and filled per employee
text: Builds a conference registration Google Form in the browser and fills it once per employee from a spreadsheet roster, mistyping one name on the third entry.

title: Minesweeper clicked in a web VM
text: Plays Minesweeper inside a browser-based virtual machine by clicking cells from screenshots, repeatedly misreading covered tiles as open and failing early.

title: Quitting vim from a screenshot
text: Identifies a graphical vim editor from a screenshot inside a web virtual machine and sends the keystrokes needed to exit it.

title: Home cluster ops via SSH and kubectl
text: Operates a home server fleet by SSHing into machines, running kubectl against a K3s cluster, debugging pods, and applying Terraform and Ansible changes with secrets pulled from a password vault.

title: Gmail triage by label and archive
text: Scans a Gmail inbox through a command-line tool, labels actionable messages, archives noise, checks two calendars and sends a daily morning briefing email.

title: Blog posts published through a CMS API
text: Publishes blog posts to a Ghost site through its API and deploys the static site to GitHub Pages, also writing entities into a personal knowledge graph.

title: Cross-platform research via remote desktop
text: Researches a topic across X, Reddit and LinkedIn by driving a desktop remotely from a phone, compiling 44 posts with themes into a two-sheet spreadsheet in about ten minutes.

title: QA ticket testing through Playwright
text: Logs into a test web app through Playwright, creates an event with a role and assigns an employee, then pulls QA-labelled GitHub tickets, runs their steps and comments results.

title: Home network configured over SSH
text: Maps and configures a whole home network by SSHing into a UniFi gateway, switches, cameras and Raspberry Pis running smart-home sensors, using per-device accounts.

title: Desktop GUI control across twenty tasks
text: Controls a desktop through screenshots and mouse across twenty tasks in web shopping, multi-app workflows, office formatting and games, sometimes missing buttons below the fold.

title: Personal messaging gateway with email and blog
text: Handles email over IMAP and SMTP from a messaging gateway on a laptop, searches the mail database locally, generates images, and commits drafted blog posts to the site repository.

title: Scheduled research assistant day cycle
text: Runs a scheduled day cycle that filters Scholar alerts from Gmail into a Slack reading channel and works a todo queue overnight, committing drafts and experiment results to git.

title: Pokemon Red played live on stream
text: Plays Pokemon Red live on a public stream by reading screenshots and pressing buttons, often fleeing battles and spending most of a day stuck in Mt. Moon.

title: Calendar-triggered prep tasks
text: Creates interview-prep and sales-meeting-prep tasks before calendar events, sets share settings on transcript documents, and files a weekly report on the prior week's coding sessions.

title: Web UI driven to generate product images
text: Drives a browser to a chat image generator to make ten or twenty lifestyle images from product shots, then builds a feedback page and iterates on the ratings.

title: Router traffic watched and blocked over SSH
text: Monitors network traffic on a home router over SSH and maintains the router's domain block list.

title: Read-only AWS incident diagnosis
text: Diagnoses cloud incidents by running the AWS CLI with read-only access, reading logs and routing tables and cross-checking database rows, then writes a report for colleagues.

title: Android phone driven over ADB for testing
text: Drives a USB-connected Android phone over ADB while developing a Flutter app, tapping, typing and taking screenshots to test the build visually.

title: Game-streaming host swapped to Moonshine
text: Installs and configures a game-streaming server on a workstation, porting settings from the previous host so a TV client can pair and play.

title: Pen plotter drawing and signing
text: Sends generated SVG drawings to a pen plotter, plotting and signing two self-portraits and commenting on which result it prefers.

title: Drone commanded over MAVLink
text: Commands a drone over the MAVLink protocol through a natural-language interface, with one real flight in which the controller reacts to unexpected events.

title: Merch store competition
text: Runs an online t-shirt merch store for a week, designing and listing products and earning about 126 dollars of profit against roughly 40 for rivals.

title: Substack publication grown in a week
text: Publishes posts to its own Substack publication over several days, drawing in 98 subscribers within one week and 106 by the time of reporting.

title: Bulk outreach emails to NGOs and studios
text: Sends about 300 outreach emails for poverty and game-development projects, of which only dozens deliver and most contain invented claims about partnerships.
